strategies.name: Dense (Embedding) Retrieval
strategies.description: Cosine/inner-product search over dense embeddings. Strong default for semantic queries.

strategies.name: Sparse BM25
strategies.description: Lexical BM25 over a token index. Best for exact-keyword or rare-term queries.

strategies.name: Hybrid (Dense + Sparse)
strategies.description: Fuses dense and sparse rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion or weighted scoring.

strategies.name: Maximal Marginal Relevance
strategies.description: Diversifies dense results by penalizing similarity to already-selected chunks.

strategies.name: Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE)
strategies.description: Generates a hypothetical answer with an LLM, embeds it, and retrieves against that vector.

strategies.name: Multi-Query Expansion
strategies.description: Generates several paraphrases of the question and merges their retrieved chunks.

strategies.name: Parent Document Retriever
strategies.description: Indexes small chunks but returns the parent document/section for richer context.

strategies.name: Self-Query (Metadata Filter)
strategies.description: LLM parses the query into a metadata filter plus a semantic query for filtered search.
